Maria G.: Quick sync — planning the Morning Spark launch email sequence. Goal: 3-touch nurture over 10 days, with webinar invite on day 4.
AJ: 👍 Target list = product-trialers + engaged newsletter opens (last 30d). Split by company size for messaging.
Olivia (Content): Drafted three subject line groups, dropping options here:
- `Wake up your product with Morning Spark`
- `How teams cut gen cost by 2x — join our demo`
- `Morning Spark: quick wins for your first week`
Kevin - Growth Ops: Sending windows: NA: 9am-11am PT, EU: 10am-12pm CET, APAC: 10am-12pm SGT. Stagger sends across regions, 24-36h apart to preserve capacity.
Maria G.: For segmentation:
- Cohort A: startups (<50) — highlight low-cost/PLG integration
- Cohort B: mid-market (50-500) — focus on SLA & dedicated capacity
- Cohort C: enterprise (>500) — webinar + private deployment CTA
AJ: Can we map subject variants to cohorts? A/B test variant per cohort, 1:1:1.
Olivia (Content): Yep. I'll pair the friendliest subject with Cohort A, a reliability angle for B, and a compliance-forward subject for C.
Kevin - Growth Ops: Reminder: suppress anyone who got product-launch email in last 14 days. Also exclude customers flagged as "do not market" in Salesforce.
Maria G.: Webinar logistics — demo team available Tue, 4/21 at 11am PT. Ask: do we promote the webinar in the day-4 touch or earlier?
AJ: I'd put a light mention in touch 1 (optional sign-up) and full push in touch 3 (day 4). Touch 2 stays product-value focused.
Olivia (Content): Draft copy for touch 1 quick preview and CTA to RSVP. Will drop drafts by EOD.
Kevin - Growth Ops: I'll push the segment and seed lists to Braze tonight, include timezone stamping. Will also set throttling to 100r/s for initial send window.
Maria G.: Metrics to watch: open rate, CTR to signups, webinar RSVPs, and 7-day activation for trialers. Set dashboard with funnel.
launch-bot: deploy scheduled: campaign/morning-spark/2026-04-19T02:00Z (status: scheduled) :rocket:
Olivia (Content): Quick ask — subject line length cap 65 chars for mobile. Noted in drafts.
AJ: Thanks — can we do a small nurture microcopy test on CTA copy: "Get the demo" vs "See Morning Spark in action"?
Maria G.: Yes. Make it a nested A/B in send platform. Kevin, add variant flag.
Kevin - Growth Ops: Will do. Adding flags `cta_short` and `cta_long` to cohort splits.
Olivia (Content): I'll also add a 1-sentence social post for the launch page.
Maria G.: Great. If everyone is aligned I'll mark this thread as the canonical plan. Action items: Olivia drafts (EOD), Kevin seeds lists (tonight), AJ sets A/B matrix (tomorrow), Maria to build dashboard.
AJ: 👍
Kevin - Growth Ops: On it.
Maria G.: Thanks team :pray:
